note: Large Stanislaus NF campground run by Dodge Ridge Mountain Resort, in loops A-E under tall pines beside Pinecrest Lake's day-use beach, marina and store, at 5,600 ft. Paved spurs vary in length; 51 sites are capped at 20 ft. Summer sites go only by reservation. A dump station ($10) is on Highway 108 nearby. --Claude
